CustomField.description: Self-referencing Id stamped on clones: holds the originating Form_Template__c Id. The clone controller sets it and queries siblings by it; the before/after triggers use it to suppress default-header seeding, auto Prefill Template creation, and the default first-page insert so clones reuse the source's structure instead of regenerating it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System field that links a cloned template back to the template it was copied from. Managed automatically by the clone action — you normally don't edit this.
CustomField.label: SourceId
